requirements.statement: The system SHALL provide page load times of less than 3 seconds for standard operations under normal load conditions.
The system SHALL provide search results within 2 seconds for standard search queries.
The system SHALL complete AI matching operations within 5 seconds for individual job-candidate matches.
The system SHALL process batch operations (e.g., bulk candidate matching) within a timeframe proportional to the batch size, not exceeding 2 minutes for standard operations.
The system SHALL maintain response time degradation of no more than 50% during peak load periods.
The system SHALL support at least 1,000 concurrent users during normal operations.
The system SHALL support at least 5,000 concurrent users during peak periods.
The system SHALL process at least 100 job applications per minute during peak periods.
The system SHALL support at least 500 new job postings per day.
The system SHALL support at least 1,000 new user registrations per day.
The system SHALL operate within the allocated server resources, utilizing no more than 80% of CPU capacity during normal operations.
The system SHALL utilize no more than 80% of available memory during normal operations.
The system SHALL require no more than 5TB of storage for the first year of operation, with a growth plan for subsequent years.
The system SHALL optimize database queries to minimize I/O operations and response times.
The system SHALL implement caching mechanisms to reduce resource utilization for frequently accessed data.
The system SHALL be designed to scale horizontally by adding more server instances to handle increased load.
The system SHALL be designed to scale vertically by utilizing additional resources on existing servers.
The system SHALL support a minimum of 100,000 registered job seekers without performance degradation.
The system SHALL support a minimum of 10,000 registered employers without performance degradation.
The system SHALL support a minimum of 50,000 active job postings without performance degradation.
The system SHALL be designed to accommodate a 100% annual growth in user base and transaction volume for at least the first three years of operation.
The system SHALL implement multi-factor authentication for administrative accounts and as an option for all users.
The system SHALL enforce strong password policies, including minimum length, complexity, and regular password changes.
The system SHALL implement role-based access control (RBAC) to restrict access to features and data based on user roles.
The system SHALL maintain detailed access logs for all authentication and authorization events.
The system SHALL automatically lock accounts after a specified number of failed login attempts.
The system SHALL implement secure session management with appropriate timeout settings.
The system SHALL support OAuth 2.0 and OpenID Connect for third-party authentication where applicable.
The system SHALL encrypt all sensitive data at rest using industry-standard encryption algorithms (AES-256 or equivalent).
The system SHALL encrypt all data in transit using TLS 1.3 or higher.
The system SHALL implement data masking for sensitive information displayed in the user interface.
The system SHALL implement secure key management practices for encryption keys.
The system SHALL provide mechanisms for secure data deletion when required.
The system SHALL implement database-level encryption for sensitive tables and columns.
The system SHALL maintain separate environments for development, testing, and production with appropriate data isolation.
The system SHALL comply with Palestinian data protection regulations and incorporate GDPR principles as best practice.
The system SHALL provide mechanisms for users to view, export, and delete their personal data in accordance with data protection regulations.
The system SHALL maintain audit trails of all data access and modifications for compliance purposes.
The system SHALL implement data minimization principles, collecting only necessary information for system functionality.
The system SHALL provide clear privacy notices and obtain appropriate consent for data collection and processing.
The system SHALL implement data retention policies in compliance with legal requirements.
The system SHALL support data protection impact assessments (DPIA) for high-risk processing activities.
The system SHALL implement comprehensive logging of security-relevant events.
The system SHALL provide real-time monitoring and alerting for security incidents.
The system SHALL implement intrusion detection and prevention mechanisms.
The system SHALL conduct regular security scans and vulnerability assessments.
The system SHALL have a documented incident response plan for security breaches.
The system SHALL implement rate limiting and other protections against denial-of-service attacks.
The system SHALL provide mechanisms for security patch management and updates.
The system SHALL maintain 99.5% availability during standard operating hours (8:00 AM to 8:00 PM Palestine time, Sunday through Thursday).
The system SHALL maintain 99.0% availability during non-standard hours.
The system SHALL schedule maintenance windows during periods of lowest expected usage.
The system SHALL provide advance notice of scheduled maintenance to all users.
The system SHALL implement high availability architecture to minimize single points of failure.
The system SHALL continue to function with degraded performance in the event of component failures.
The system SHALL implement database replication to prevent data loss in case of database failures.
The system SHALL implement load balancing across multiple servers to distribute traffic and prevent overload.
The system SHALL automatically recover from common failure scenarios without manual intervention.
The system SHALL implement circuit breaker patterns for external service dependencies to prevent cascading failures.
The system SHALL maintain regular backups of all data, with full backups at least weekly and incremental backups daily.
The system SHALL store backups in geographically separate locations from the primary system.
The system SHALL define and document Recovery Time Objective (RTO) of 4 hours for critical functions and 24 hours for non-critical functions.
The system SHALL define and document Recovery Point Objective (RPO) of 1 hour, meaning no more than 1 hour of data loss in a disaster scenario.
The system SHALL have a documented and tested disaster recovery plan.
The system SHALL conduct disaster recovery drills at least twice per year.
The system SHALL provide meaningful error messages to users without exposing sensitive system information.
The system SHALL log detailed error information for troubleshooting and monitoring.
The system SHALL handle input validation errors gracefully, providing clear feedback to users.
The system SHALL implement appropriate retry mechanisms for transient errors.
The system SHALL maintain system stability when encountering unexpected inputs or conditions.
The system SHALL provide a consistent and intuitive user interface across all functions.
The system SHALL implement responsive design to support various screen sizes and devices.
The system SHALL provide clear navigation and information architecture.
The system SHALL use consistent terminology and design patterns throughout the interface.
The system SHALL provide appropriate feedback for user actions.
The system SHALL minimize the number of steps required to complete common tasks.
The system SHALL provide context-sensitive help and guidance.
The system SHALL comply with Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.1 Level AA standards.
The system SHALL support screen readers and other assistive technologies.
The system SHALL provide keyboard navigation for all functions.
The system SHALL ensure sufficient color contrast for text and interactive elements.
The system SHALL provide text alternatives for non-text content.
The system SHALL ensure that form elements have associated labels.
The system SHALL provide mechanisms to pause, stop, or hide moving content.
The system SHALL provide full functionality in both Arabic and English languages.
The system SHALL allow users to switch between languages at any point in the application.
The system SHALL support right-to-left (RTL) text direction for Arabic content.
The system SHALL ensure that date, time, and number formats are appropriate for the selected language and locale.
The system SHALL provide a consistent translation quality across all interface elements.
The system SHALL support multilingual content for job postings and user profiles.
The system SHALL implement language detection to suggest the appropriate language based on user settings and location.
The system SHALL provide a personalized user experience based on user preferences and behavior.
The system SHALL implement progressive disclosure of complex features to avoid overwhelming users.
The system SHALL provide clear onboarding processes for new users.
The system SHALL collect and incorporate user feedback for continuous improvement.
The system SHALL support different user skill levels, from novice to expert.
The system SHALL minimize user cognitive load by presenting information in manageable chunks.
The system SHALL provide appropriate defaults to reduce the need for user configuration.
The system SHALL be designed with a modular architecture to facilitate maintenance and updates.
The system SHALL follow consistent coding standards and best practices.
The system SHALL include comprehensive technical documentation for all components.
The system SHALL implement logging and monitoring to facilitate troubleshooting.
The system SHALL support configuration changes without requiring code modifications.
The system SHALL implement automated testing with a minimum of 80% code coverage.
The system SHALL support version control for all system artifacts.
The system SHALL be designed to operate in different hosting environments (on-premises, cloud, or hybrid).
The system SHALL use containerization technologies to ensure consistent deployment across environments.
The system SHALL minimize dependencies on specific hardware or operating system features.
The system SHALL support database portability through abstraction layers.
The system SHALL provide documented deployment procedures for different environments.
The system SHALL support automated deployment and configuration.
The system SHALL be compatible with the latest versions of major web browsers (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge).
The system SHALL be compatible with the previous two major versions of supported browsers.
The system SHALL be compatible with mobile browsers on iOS and Android platforms.
The system SHALL be compatible with standard email clients for notification delivery.
The system SHALL support standard file formats for data import and export (CSV, JSON, XML).
The system SHALL implement standard protocols for integration with external systems.
The system SHALL comply with all applicable Palestinian labor laws and regulations.
The system SHALL incorporate GDPR principles as best practice for data protection.
The system SHALL comply with accessibility regulations and standards.
The system SHALL maintain appropriate records for regulatory compliance and auditing.
The system SHALL implement mechanisms to stay current with changing regulatory requirements.
The system SHALL respect intellectual property rights in all content and functionality.
The system SHALL properly license all third-party components and libraries.
The system SHALL provide appropriate attribution for third-party content.
The system SHALL implement mechanisms to prevent copyright infringement by users.
The system SHALL define and document service level agreements (SLAs) for system availability.
The system SHALL define and document SLAs for incident response and resolution times.
The system SHALL define and document SLAs for support services.
The system SHALL implement monitoring and reporting mechanisms to track SLA compliance.
The system SHALL define escalation procedures for SLA violations.
The system SHALL implement comprehensive logging for all system components.
The system SHALL provide real-time monitoring of system health and performance.
The system SHALL generate alerts for critical system events and performance thresholds.
The system SHALL maintain log retention policies in compliance with legal requirements.
The system SHALL provide dashboards for monitoring system status and performance metrics.
The system SHALL implement log aggregation and analysis tools.
The system SHALL perform automated backups according to defined schedules.
The system SHALL verify backup integrity through automated testing.
The system SHALL provide mechanisms for point-in-time recovery.
The system SHALL document and test restoration procedures.
The system SHALL maintain backup history and audit trails.
The system SHALL provide administrative interfaces for system configuration and management.
The system SHALL support role-based access for administrative functions.
The system SHALL provide tools for user management and support.
The system SHALL implement change management procedures for system modifications.
The system SHALL provide mechanisms for content moderation and management.
The system SHALL support system health checks and diagnostics.
The system SHALL provide comprehensive user documentation for all user roles.
The system SHALL provide technical documentation for system administrators and developers.
The system SHALL maintain up-to-date system architecture and design documentation.
The system SHALL provide API documentation for integration partners.
The system SHALL document all configuration parameters and their effects.
The system SHALL provide troubleshooting guides and known issue documentation.
The system SHALL respect cultural norms and sensitivities in the Palestinian context.
The system SHALL use appropriate terminology and language for the local context.
The system SHALL support local date and time formats, including Hijri calendar references where appropriate.
The system SHALL consider gender sensitivities in user interfaces and communications.
The system SHALL use politically neutral terminology in system interfaces and documentation.
The system SHALL respect the political sensitivities of the region in geographic references and maps.
The system SHALL implement appropriate content moderation policies for politically sensitive content.
The system SHALL ensure equitable access for users across all Palestinian territories, including Gaza and the West Bank (including East Jerusalem).
Support for adding additional languages in the future - Separation of UI text from code for easy translation - Localization of images and media where appropriate
Support for different date, time, and number formats - Adaptation of content for cultural appropriateness - Consideration of cultural differences in UI design
Support for regional variations in language (e.g., different Arabic dialects) - Region-specific content and features - Compliance with regional regulations
